confidence_notes: FX is from an RBA search result: the 18 Nov 2026 observation of 0.6720 USD per AUD. Food and drink anchors rest on one web search of travel-budget sites, which disagree with each other and are not official price surveys. I used mid-to-upper values because the reference window is July peak season. Cocktail and wine are set from the ranges in that search and their usual relationship to beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for peak summer, not from live listings, and carry the most uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with Dubrovnik, which is more expensive, and with other Adriatic tourist cities such as Kotor and Zadar. Split sits in the upper-middle of Mediterranean Europe in July. I assumed 1 EUR is about 1.15 USD.
